    • enumOf

      public ParameterSchema.Builder enumOf(String name, WireEnum[] values, String description)
      Add a closed-set string property whose allowed values come from a Tier-1 WireEnum array — typically RecordFormat.values() / Codec.values() etc. Each constant contributes its WireEnum.getValue() wire string, producing a JSON-Schema enum:[...] of those exact strings (so it is byte-identical to hand-writing the same string list).
      Parameters:
      name - property name.
      values - the enum constants (e.g. RecordFormat.values()).
      description - LLM-facing description.
      Returns:
      this builder.

    • enumOf

      public ParameterSchema.Builder enumOf(String name, Collection<String> values, String description)
      Add a closed-set string property with an explicit list of allowed string values (for closed sets that are not modelled as a Tier-1 enum — e.g. a venue's amenity names). Produces a JSON-Schema enum:[...] in the given order.
      Parameters:
      name - property name.
      values - the allowed values.
      description - LLM-facing description.
      Returns:
      this builder.

    • enumOf

      public ParameterSchema.Builder enumOf(String name, String description, String... values)
      Convenience varargs form of enumOf(String, Collection, String) where the description comes first so the trailing varargs read as the value set.
      Parameters:
      name - property name.
      description - LLM-facing description.
      values - the allowed values.
      Returns:
      this builder.

    • array

      public ParameterSchema.Builder array(String name, String itemType, String description)
      Add an array property whose items are a scalar JSON-Schema kind ("string", "number", "integer", "boolean"). Produces {"type":"array","description":…, "items":{"type":itemType}}.
      Parameters:
      name - property name.
      itemType - the scalar item kind.
      description - LLM-facing description.
      Returns:
      this builder.

    • arrayOfObjects

      public ParameterSchema.Builder arrayOfObjects(String name, Map<String,Object> itemSchema, String description)
      Add an array property whose items are a nested object schema built with another ParameterSchema. Produces {"type":"array","description":…,"items":{<nested schema>}}.
      Parameters:
      name - property name.
      itemSchema - the built schema for each array element (from build()).
      description - LLM-facing description.
      Returns:
      this builder.

    • object

      public ParameterSchema.Builder object(String name, Map<String,Object> objectSchema, String description)
      Add a nested object property whose schema is built with another ParameterSchema. The nested schema's type, properties (and required, if any) are merged in alongside this property's description, producing {"type":"object","description":…,"properties":{…}}.
      Parameters:
      name - property name.
      objectSchema - the built nested schema (from build()).
      description - LLM-facing description.
      Returns:
      this builder.

      public ParameterSchema.Builder defaultValue(Object value)

      public ParameterSchema.Builder format(String format)

      Returns:

    • required

      public ParameterSchema.Builder required(String... names)
      Mark one or more properties as required. Names are kept in declaration order and de-duplicated; calling this multiple times accumulates. If no name is ever marked required, the built schema omits the required key entirely.
      Parameters:
      names - property names to require.
      Returns:
      this builder.

    • build

      public Map<String,Object> build()
      Build the JSON-Schema parameters Map. The result is a LinkedHashMap ordered type → properties → required (with required omitted when empty) — byte-for-byte identical to the hand-written nested-map form. Each call returns a fresh, independent Map; the builder may be reused.
      Returns:
      the parameters Map, ready to pass to ToolDefinition / defineTool.
